requirement: Safely resize noncanonical DOCX story pictures while preserving the source XML envelope, DrawingML frame/shape extents, ownership, relationships, resources, and unrelated OPC parts.
supportedScope: Standalone top-level wp:inline embedded pictures in linked headers, footers, footnotes, and endnotes. The exact positive source wp:extent and a:xfrm/a:ext EMUs are retained as nonserialized format metadata. An unchanged picture writes the original exact values; a resize scales each inner axis from its source frame ratio using checked integer rounding. Group children, non-inline placements, unsupported/transformed picture envelopes, malformed or out-of-range extents, and source packages whose initial WordCraft serialization is not provably unchanged remain fail-closed.

wordcraftReconstruction.details: Fresh public base reconstructed the exact sanitized commit, verified the ordered full-index patch chain and a clean submodule, and independently cargo-checked wordcraft-fonts.

focusedGeul.coverage: Initial source-envelope preservation, offered resize, exact proportional dual extents, T009 save check, fresh model reopen, unrelated OPC/header/footer preservation, Undo/Redo, and rejection of an unauthorized one-EMU inner-extent mutation.
